Tests:
assert smartNumber(1) == 30
assert smartNumber(50) == 273
assert smartNumber(1000) == 2664

Write the t task named `smartNumber` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) int, in the order the tests pass them, returning int. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
